name: un_get_trade_balance
description:
Goods trade balance (exports minus imports, USD) of one country with the world or one partner for a year, as reported by that country to UN Comtrade.
Returns: country_code, partner_code, year, data {exports, imports, balance} (null when a flow is missing) and a source note.
Inputs (* required): country_code* (ISO3 such as USA, or a numeric Comtrade code); partner_code (same, or all for the world; default all); year (1962-2030; default the current year minus 2).
For partner and commodity detail use un_get_trade_data; for totals with top partners un_get_country_trade. Key: optional COMTRADE_API_KEY for the full Comtrade API; without it the keyless preview API (500 rows, rate limited).
Example: {"country_code": "USA", "partner_code": "CHN", "year": 2022}

partner_code.description: Partner country ISO3 code (optional, defaults to 'all' for overall world trade balance)

year.description: Year for calculation (defaults to previous year)

exports.description: Total exports to partner/world in USD

imports.description: Total imports from partner/world in USD

balance.description: Trade balance (exports - imports) in USD. Positive indicates trade surplus, negative indicates deficit.

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Trade balance is a key economic indicator. A positive balance (surplus) means exports exceed imports; a negative balance (deficit) means imports exceed exports. Data comes from the keyless UN Comtrade public preview API; set COMTRADE_API_KEY to use the full data API.
